{
  "name": "nwsapi",
  "version": "2.2.28",
  "description": "Fast CSS Selectors API Engine",
  "keywords": [
    "css",
    "css3",
    "css4",
    "matcher",
    "selector"
  ],
  "homepage": "https://javascript.nwbox.com/nwsapi/",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/dperini/nwsapi/issues"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": {
    "name": "Diego Perini",
    "email": "diego.perini@gmail.com",
    "web": "https://www.iport.it/"
  },
  "maintainers": [
    {
      "name": "Diego Perini",
      "email": "diego.perini@gmail.com",
      "web": "https://www.iport.it/"
    }
  ],
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/dperini/nwsapi.git"
  },
  "main": "./src/nwsapi",
  "scripts": {
    "preinstall": "node scripts/package-manager.mjs",
    "clean": "node scripts/clean.mts",
    "dev": "node scripts/develop/run.mts",
    "docs": "node scripts/develop/docs.mts",
    "lint": "eslint ./src/nwsapi.js",
    "npm:approve": "node scripts/publish/npm/approve.mjs",
    "npm:auth": "node scripts/publish/npm/auth.mjs",
    "npm:dry-run": "node scripts/publish/npm/stage.mjs --dry-run",
    "npm:finalize": "node scripts/publish/npm/finalize.mjs",
    "npm:publish": "node scripts/publish/npm/publish.mjs",
    "npm:reject": "node scripts/publish/npm/reject.mjs",
    "npm:stage": "node scripts/publish/npm/stage.mjs",
    "npm:staged": "node scripts/publish/npm/staged.mjs",
    "npm:verify": "node scripts/publish/npm/verify.mjs",
    "prepare": "node scripts/setup.mjs",
    "prepublishOnly": "node scripts/publish/block-publish.cjs",
    "publish:setup": "node scripts/publish/setup.mjs",
    "setup": "node scripts/setup.mjs",
    "setup:editor": "node scripts/setup/editor.mts",
    "setup:check": "node scripts/develop/doctor.mts",
    "review": "node scripts/develop/review.mts",
    "test": "node --test test/repo/integration/*.test.mjs test/repo/integration/fastpaths/*.test.mjs test/repo/integration/setup/*.test.mjs test/repo/release/*.test.mjs",
    "wpt:serve": "node test/wpt/wpt-launcher.mjs serve",
    "wpt:setup": "node test/wpt/wpt-launcher.mjs setup",
    "wpt:verify": "node test/wpt/wpt-launcher.mjs verify",
    "wpt:test": "node test/wpt/wpt-test.mjs",
    "setup:full": "node scripts/setup.mjs --full",
    "test:onboarding": "node scripts/test/onboarding/run.mts journey"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "10.0.1",
    "@maschwenk/tsrs": "0.8.0-ts7.1.0-dev.20260929",
    "@opentui/core": "0.5.17",
    "@typescript/native-preview": "7.0.0-dev.20260707.2",
    "acorn": "8.15.0",
    "eslint": "10.12.0",
    "globals": "17.13.0",
    "jsdom": "26.1.0",
    "playwright": "1.63.0",
    "std-env": "4.3.0"
  },
  "engines": {
    "npm": ">=12.2.0"
  },
  "licenses": [
    {
      "type": "MIT",
      "url": "https://javascript.nwbox.com/nwsapi/MIT-LICENSE"
    }
  ]
}
